question: Who took charge as the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA) on 1 March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Mayank Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Dr. Mayank Sharma took charge as the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA) on **1 March 2025**.
 
• He succeeded the outgoing CGDA and assumed the role, becoming the top authority in the Defence Accounts Department (DAD), a key financial management body of the Ministry of Defence, Government of India.
 
• The CGDA is responsible for providing financial advice, budgetary control, and payment services to the armed forces
